description: Compact corrections and optional next-text suggestions for bounded keyboard context.

operations.description: Analyze bounded keyboard context for compact corrections and predictions.
rules: Analyze this bounded keyboard context and return strict JSON only. Do not include markdown or explanations outside JSON.
Return corrections and predictions separately using this schema:
Corrections modify existing text. Predictions are optional next-word/phrase/synonym suggestions. Keep replacements and prediction text short for a compact keyboard bar.
operations.no_change_behavior: Return empty corrections and predictions arrays when no usable suggestion exists.
